claims.head: Daccord’s hold on the Panthers won’t last
claims.body: Since 2023-24, Daccord has been a wall against the Panthers, well above his usual. Fans love a pattern like this, but we checked three seasons of them and they predicted nothing. Don’t be surprised if the Panthers finally get to him.
claims.nums: 6 starts against Florida: .936 save percentage · .905 against everyone else
claims.gist: Don’t read much into Daccord’s record against the Panthers.
claims.call: If Daccord starts, his save percentage lands closer to his usual .905 than to his .936 against the Panthers.
claims.cite: Goalie starts since 2023-24 · 6 against Florida, 4,141 shots against everyone else

chips.tip: Daccord: .936 save percentage in 6 starts against Florida since 2023-24.
Daccord: .905 save percentage against everyone else since 2023-24, on 4,141 shots.

claims.head: The Kraken can’t afford to take penalties
claims.call: The Panthers’ power play creates at least their usual 8.5 expected goals per 60.
claims.body: The Kraken’s penalty kill is near the bottom of the league, and the Panthers’ power play is one of the best. Discipline matters more than usual for the Kraken tonight.
claims.nums: Florida 5th for power play (8.5 expected goals per 60) · Seattle 26th for penalty kill

claims.head: The Panthers lock it down, the Kraken don’t
claims.body: The Panthers keep shots away, but the Kraken give up plenty. Florida is one of the league’s best for shot suppression, and Seattle is the worst. They’re about as far apart as two teams get. Expect the Kraken to give up the bigger pile of shots.

notes.text: Cale Fleury has not dressed for the last 4 games. He is one of their more valuable skaters.
Brandon Montour is out (lower body injury), reported after he played in their last game. He is a top-four defenseman.
Vince Dunn has started killing penalties: on the ice for 39% of the team’s shorthanded time in 8 games, up from 2% last season.
Aleksander Barkov is on long-term injured reserve (lower-body injury) and has missed the last 6 games. He is one of their best players.
Brad Marchand is on injured reserve (leg injury) and has missed the last 4 games.

FLA.head: Advantage, the Panthers
FLA.body: Even though Florida will be without Barkov, the Panthers have been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and have home-ice advantage. The Kraken’s way back in is keeping dangerous shots away.

SEA.head: The Kraken have a hill to climb
SEA.body: Even though Florida will be without Barkov, the Panthers have been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and have home-ice advantage. The Kraken can pull it off if they keep dangerous shots away.

paras: The Panthers have won two in a row. The Kraken are 5-2-1.

items.text: Mackie Samoskevich faces Florida for the first time since leaving.

The Panthers have been without Aleksander Barkov and Brad Marchand for several games.
Eetu Luostarinen has scored in three straight games against Seattle.
